testimonials.name: Basheer Ali
testimonials.highlight: I've achieved goals I never thought possible
testimonials.text: I can't recommend Akram enough! Their expertise and personalized approach have truly transformed my fitness journey. They create engaging workouts that challenge me while keeping it fun. Akram is always supportive and motivates me to push my limits. Thanks to their guidance, I've achieved goals I never thought possible. If you're looking for a dedicated and knowledgeable trainer, look no further!

testimonials.name: Sultan Almansoori
testimonials.highlight: Amazing results in just a few months
testimonials.text: I've tried several gyms, but Muscularity Fitness stands out for its community feel. The trainers genuinely care about my progress, and I've seen amazing results in just a few months!

testimonials.name: Mohammed Ehtesham
testimonials.text: Having a personal trainer come to my house has been a game-changer. I'm able to fit workouts into my busy schedule without the hassle of commuting to a gym. Muscularity Fitness has made my fitness journey convenient and effective!

testimonials.name: Sofia Ahmed
testimonials.text: Akram has to be one of the best fitness trainers as he is a very dedicated and knowledgeable person in the fitness world. His plan and tips helped me approach to a new and healthy lifestyle. He is very understanding and caring about his clients! Highly recommended person if you want to kickstart your fitness journey!

testimonials.name: Moon Dasuqi
testimonials.text: Best coach ever .. I hope all the best for you .. go ahead .. you are the best

faqs.a: Wherever suits you: at your home, outdoors, or in the gym. Tell us where when you book, and we plan the session around it.

faqs.q: How much does personal training cost?
faqs.a: From AED 135 / session. Body Reboot is AED 135 / session, Elite AED 155 / session, Pro AED 175 / session and VIP AED 195 / session. Total Transformation and Lifestyle Coach are priced to your goal.

faqs.q: Is the first session really free?
faqs.a: Yes. Book a free trial session so we can get to know you and your goals before you choose a package.

faqs.q: I'm a complete beginner. Is that OK?
faqs.a: Yes. Every programme starts from your current level, from first-timers to experienced athletes.
Yes. Nutrition guidance is part of our coaching, so your training and your eating work together.
We're based in Abu Dhabi. Send us your area on WhatsApp and we'll confirm straight away.
